'''Eternal Xiranite Overalls''' is a {{gear|5|Armor}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Hongshan Swordmancers and assembled by the AIC. This equipment can improve the wearer's combat capabilities.|Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
Its excessive simplicity has a perk. A wearer who survives a battle can often find usable plugins and modules from their fallen comrades, further ensuring their own life expectancy.}}
